b: Emerald Guitars has unveiled four new models in its flagship X20 family of acoustic guitars, alongside the launch of Noir by Emerald Guitars, a distinct new identity built around focused specifications and accessible pricing.

For the new X20 models—the third generation in this product line—Emerald has redesigned its best-selling acoustic platform around sound, playing comfort, and personal expression, drawing on more than 25 years of carbon fiber guitar-building experience.

The new design features a sound hole that flows across the top and side of the instrument, an updated neck profile, and further refinements throughout. Truss rod adjustment is now accessed internally through the sound hole, creating a cleaner headstock appearance.
X20 Steel String: A balanced, responsive acoustic suited to fingerstyle, strumming, and a wide range of playing styles. (Street price: $2,585)
X20 Short Scale: A new 24-inch scale-length option offering a more relaxed string feel. (Street price: $2,585)
X20 Nylon: Nylon-string character paired with contemporary playability and carbon fiber construction. (Street price: $4,200)
X20-12-String: The rich, shimmering voice of a 12-string acoustic on the redesigned platform. (Street price: $3,025)

All four models feature Emerald's signature carbon fiber construction and unidirectional carbon fiber fretboards. The X20 Steel String, X20 Nylon, and X20-12 String feature a 25.5-inch scale length, while the new X20 Short Scale has a 24-inch scale length, offering closer fret spacing and reduced string tension.

The main Emerald range also offers extensive customization options, with different carbon weaves, colors, decorative wood veneers, hardware, inlays, and pickup configurations available through the online 3D Guitar Builder.

At the same time as the new X20 launch, Emerald is introducing a sub-brand: Noir by Emerald Guitars is a distinct product line within the Emerald family, with its own brand identity and design philosophy. Building on the performance-focused approach of Emerald's previous Black Opus series, Noir offers a carefully defined specification, distinctive visual identity, and more accessible pricing.
Unlike the main Emerald range, which offers extensive customization, Noir models are offered in a fixed configuration designed around tone, playability, reliability, and performance.

The X20 Noir is the first instrument in this new product line, built around the newly redesigned third-generation X20 platform. Every Noir guitar is designed and manufactured at Emerald Guitars HQ in Donegal, Ireland, by the same team responsible for the company's main range.

Players can explore the new instruments through Emerald’s website and interactive 3D learning environment. Custom options for the main Emerald range are available through the 3D Guitar Builder; Noir is offered in its defined specification. For more information, visit emeraldguitars.com.
